title: runner: input channel for workflows run by a retry reference

raw.title: runner: input channel for workflows run by a retry reference
raw.body:
A `retry` failure action's `workflowId` reference runs the referenced workflow with empty inputs (`{}`) — the spec gives the retry action no input-mapping mechanism, the same gap `dependsOn` has.

**Decided 2026-08-17 (reference-retry design, `packages/runner/WORKFLOW_EXECUTOR_PLAN.md`): `{}` is the spec-honest fallback; a repair flow needing inputs is better modeled by the author as a sub-workflow step rather than a retry reference.**

If real-world flows need parameterized repair, options to weigh here:
- (a) extend the caller-supplied `dependencyInputs` map (currently feeds implicitly-run `dependsOn` workflows) to cover retry references too, keyed the same way;
- (b) a dedicated `referenceInputs` execute option, scoped to retry references only.

Blocked on demand, not on design — no implementation needed until a concrete need shows up. Tracking only.
